data.title: Google to invest record $15 billion in AI infrastructure in the 'Texas of Europe'
data.description: Google on Wednesday said it would invest $15.1 billion into AI infrastructure in Finland, marking the tech giant's largest single investment in Europe.
data.author: Kai Nicol-Schwarz
